Who We Are

Who Are The Sent Ones?

"As the Father has sent Me, I am sending you."

— John 20:21

The Sent Ones is a movement of believers within Redeemer's University committed to fulfilling the Great Commission through intentional evangelism.

Just as God sent Jesus to reveal His love and save humanity, Jesus has entrusted us with the responsibility of taking that same message to others.

We believe evangelism is not a ministry for a few people. It is the calling of every believer.

  • The campus is our mission field
  • The students are our harvest
  • The Gospel is our message
  • Jesus is our focus
The Weight of the Call

Why This Mandate Matters

🕊️

A Divine Command

"Go therefore and make disciples of all nations..." — Matthew 28:19. The Great Commission was not merely a suggestion. It was a command given by the risen Christ Himself to every believer.

⚡

The Urgent Need

Millions are searching for meaning, hope, and truth. Many students struggle silently with depression, fear, confusion, and spiritual emptiness. The Gospel of Jesus Christ remains the only answer.

🌾

Laborers Are Few

God is still seeking laborers willing to carry His light into dark places. The question is not whether God is calling — the question is whether we will answer His call.

"The harvest truly is plentiful,
but the laborers are few."

— Matthew 9:37

Where We Are Going

Raising Kingdom Ambassadors

Our vision is to build a generation of students who represent Christ in every sphere of campus life — bold, holy, and filled with the Spirit of God.

  • Love Jesus passionately
  • Live holy lives before men
  • Share the Gospel boldly
  • Disciple others faithfully
  • Represent Christ on campus
  • Advance God's Kingdom through evangelism
What We Do Every Week

The Weekly Commitment

Just 2 hours once every week.

A small sacrifice. An eternal impact.

The Heart Behind It All

Two Hours Can Change Eternity

Imagine what God can do when dozens of believers unite weekly with one goal — to tell someone about Jesus. Every outreach creates opportunities for soul winning, prayer ministry, encouragement, discipleship, and spiritual growth.

Many people are one conversation away from encountering Christ.
Will you be the one God sends?

Criteria for Membership

Who Can Join?

The Sent Ones is open to every Redeemer's University student who is willing to commit to the mission of advancing God's Kingdom on campus.

✅

Born Again

Be genuinely born again with a personal, living relationship with Jesus Christ as Lord and Saviour.

✅

Heart for Souls

Have a genuine burden for lost souls and a desire to see God's Kingdom advanced on campus.

✅

Weekly Commitment

Be willing and available to participate in joint evangelism outreaches for just 2 hours every week.

✅

Teachable Spirit

Be teachable, humble, committed, and open to growing in your faith and evangelism effectiveness.

✅

Accountability

Be willing to be spiritually accountable, to encourage others and be encouraged in return.

✅

RUN Student

Currently enrolled as a student at Redeemer's University, Ede, Osun State, Nigeria.
